_doc: The six-platform monitor's standing watch list (fr-social, 2026-10-22): medical topics and drug classes the public talks about on 小红书、抖音、知乎、微博、B站、视频号 and the frontier feed covers. Each term is searched on each platform in turn (newest posts, five detailed), the one searched longest ago first, 120 requests a day. A post found is screened like any entry; the term is not stored with it.
